message: Line 1 has '*' as the first non-blank character in columns 8-72 (column 8); skipped as a comment.

FD PROCESS-SEQ-FILE (line 33) and FD BATCH-CONTROL-FILE (line 36) have no inline 01 records; their records come from COPY PRCSEQ (line 34) and COPY BCHCTL (line 37). The copybook records are linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0046-SEC-0003) and are not registered as program FILE records. RECORD KEYs PSR-KEY (line 21) and BCT-KEY (line 28) are declared in PRCSEQ and BCHCTL.

COPY PRCSEQ under FD PROCESS-SEQ-FILE brings two 01 records (PROCESS-SEQUENCE-RECORD, 380 bytes; STANDARD-SEQUENCES, 72 bytes). STANDARD-SEQUENCES (PRCSEQ lines 63-75) carries VALUE clauses on FILLER items inside the FILE SECTION. Recorded as literal text only in the copybook layout.
